# Expected values for the removal of a finished mill (docs/rules/milling.md, docs/rules/removal.md), captured from the original
# program in the emulator (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb remove with a finished mill (type 15, a small building,
# object code 2) at the flag 15,9 and the remove click on its node. Its flag pointer (+0xe) is set by hand, as a built site leaves it
# (0x43ef82); the pointer's high bytes are left out of the building's bytes. The player setup also runs 0x44579c, which writes the word at
# +0x15a that the mill's handler (0x42e2a0) reads. The lines are the verb's output from the click on, reduced to the changes of the map,
# the miller (s3: a settler without a job the castle made the miller), the flags, the building (b2), the table counts (c), and the
# generator (rng); the castle's knights (s6 to s8) and the carriers are left out. A scenario has the miller inside waiting for grain
# (mill-inside), grinding (mill-grinding) or pausing (mill-pausing), out on the flag with the flour (mill-out), and, with a grain from the
# castle's flag (put at the pass 600), the grain on its way to the mill (mill-grain-on-the-way) or on site and not yet taken
# (mill-grain-held). Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.
